$comment: Standalone release binaries of the linters that have no hash-pinned Python package (Linux x86-64).
script/install_binaries.sh downloads `asset` ({version} substituted) of the GitHub release v{version} of
`repository`, verifies its SHA-256 and installs `member` of the archive (or the asset itself) under the tool's
name. `rake outdated` (script/outdated/tools.rb) fails when `version` is not the newest release.
